section_I.why: φu = 0 gives Nq = 1, Nγ = 0, so q_net = cu·Nc: no B, no D left.
cohesionless surface footing: only the Nγ term; 0.3γBNγ (circle) / 0.4γBNγ (square) = 3/4.

section_I.flag: formula-dependent: √(100/σ′) gives 23.4 → C (25); Peck 0.77·log(1915/σ′) gives 19.3 → B (20). Check which C_N the course uses.

section_I.why: WT deeper than B below the base: no effect (600); at the base: half (300); 1.5 m = B below: no effect (600).

section_I.flag: strict Terzaghi theory: time does not depend on the stress increase (B); some keys give A.
section_I.why: more compressible (mv up) → cv down → slower; more permeable → faster; Δσ does not enter cv.
t ∝ d²; single drainage doubles d → 4 times slower.
the slope of e vs log σ′ is Cc.
J (sharp peak) = general shear, slip to surface; K = local; L (no peak) = punching, no heave.
c and φ come from a triaxial (or direct shear) test.
Nc, Nq, Nγ depend only on φ.
very dense sand, shallow footing → general shear.
the lesser of q_ult/F and the pressure that gives the allowable settlement.

section_II.topic: bearing capacity, strip, water table at surface
lines: γ_sat, γ_w (sand) → subtract → γ′ sand = 10.19 kN/m³
γ_sat, γ_w (silt) → subtract → γ′ silt = 8.19 kN/m³
γ′ silt, 4 m → multiply → q = 32.8 kPa (silt beside the basement is the surcharge)
q, Nq = 40 → multiply → q·Nq = 1310 kPa
γ′ sand, B = 6 m, Nγ = 45 → multiply → ½γ′BNγ = 1376 kPa
c′ = 0 is a given: the c·Nc term drops
q·Nq, ½γ′BNγ → add → q_f ≈ 2686 kPa ⚑

section_II.topic: settlement from lowering the water table (mv method)
section_II.flag: convention: 125 mm keeps the dewatered sand at 20 kN/m³ (Δσ′ = 100 kPa, the common published key); 100 mm if the dewatered sand drops to 18 kN/m³ (Δσ′ = 80 kPa). Check against the marked paper.
lines: WT drop 10 m, γ_w → multiply → Δu = −100 kPa
Δu → negate → Δσ′ at mid-clay = +100 kPa (sand unit weight unchanged)
mv = 0.25 m²/MN → convert to m²/kN → 0.25×10⁻³ m²/kN (a hidden unit change)
mv, Δσ′, H = 5 m → multiply → s = 0.125 m
s → convert to mm → 125 mm ⚑
sand above, gravel below is a given → is double drainage → d = H/2 = 10 m (not needed in the end)
U < 60 % is an adjective that picks Tv = (π/4)U²
30 mm at 2 yr, 40 mm → ratio → U₂/U₁ = 4/3
Tv ∝ t and Tv ∝ U² → t₂ = t₁(U₂/U₁)² → t₂ = 2·(4/3)² ≈ 3.56 yr ⚑
c_v cancels: it is given but not used (a distractor)

section_II.topic: Schmertmann settlement from a CPT profile
section_II.flag: from the 14 Sep worked solution; not re-run on 20 Oct (needs the Iz chart from the paper).
lines: γ_sat, γ_w, D = 2 m → effective stress at the base → σ′ = 16.4 kPa
q_n = 140, σ′ → C1 = 1 − 0.5σ′/q_n (depth correction)
q_n, σ′ at the peak depth → Iz,peak = 0.5 + 0.1√(q_n/σ′_p)
qc of each layer → E = 2.5·qc (square footing) per layer
Iz at each layer middle, E, Δz → sum Iz·Δz/E
C1, C2, q_n, Σ → multiply → s ≈ 48 mm ⚑
